name: Diplomacy Harness
description: The first evaluation harness enabling any out-of-the-box LLM to play full-press Diplomacy (a 7-player board game requiring natural language negotiation, alliance formation, betrayal, and strategic planning) without fine-tuning. Introduces Critical State Analysis for analyzing key game moments and data-driven optimization of game state representation.
reputation: First harness allowing any LLM to play full-press Diplomacy without fine-tuning; unlike Meta's Cicero which required specialized training
notes: Computationally intensive (full 7-player games); larger models perform better but models down to 24B parameters remain adequate; high-variance game-level evaluation; code to be open-sourced.
